harry.k: quick note — apiserver 503 spikes in eu-central during a GPU batch rollout at 11:20 UTC. controller-manager queue hit 7k.
maya: logs show many "write: connection reset by peer" from proxy to apiserver; NAT ephemeral pool for the AZ depleted during the rollout.
aj: did we hit conntrack max?
harry.k: no, conntrack counters fine. seems like ephemeral ports exhausted due to many short-lived connections from pods attaching GPUs.
maya: mitigated by enabling TCP multiplexing on proxy and increasing ip_local_port_range and net.ipv4.ip_local_reserved_ports on NATs. also temporarily scaled apiserver replicas in that region.
aj: please capture tunables we changed in the ticket.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-411 by harry.k (sev: medium)
harry.k: followups: we should schedule a kernel rollback test for the NAT image and consider dedicated NAT pools for control-plane traffic on GPU-heavy AZs. i'll file the followup today. closing thread, moved to incident channel.
